Here's where the real work actually stands, since there's nothing new to act on:

**Done this session:**
- Added the "AUTHORIZE AUTONOMOUS QA" button to `expo/app/admin/owner-controls.tsx`, gated to `role === 'owner' || role === 'admin'` (same pattern used elsewhere in the codebase), directly below the existing `OwnerIPAccessCard`.
- It calls `supabase.auth.getSession()`, does exactly one bounded `supabase.auth.refreshSession()` retry on failure, and — only if still no session — routes to `/login` with a single retry after sign-in (no infinite loop).
- On success it POSTs to the already-deployed `POST /api/ivx/senior-developer/generate-worker-access` with `Authorization: Bearer <session.access_token>`, auto-resolving `commitSha` from the live `/version` endpoint rather than asking the owner to paste anything.
